items.title: Joe Wilder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He had never met me. So she told him I was at A&R Recording Studio... He said okay, he’d go over there, and he’d meet me when I got there.

ctx.x: It’s great to remember what it’s like to be a teenager and have this teacher.

I saw Rosario. I was doing a Miss America pageant in Atlantic City. His son Mario was playing at one of the casinos. So they came down. He knew I was there and invited me – took me to dinner. He and I started talking about that. It’s just hysterical.
Did you imagine yourself as a symphonic player? Was that something you had wanted to do?
